instruction: Find every face in the photo and enhance each one to look a decade younger using advanced retouching.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not have built-in AI face detection and automatic age-reducing retouching capabilities. Such advanced AI-powered facial manipulation would require specialized machine learning models and cannot be achieved through GIMP's standard interface or scripting capabilities in an automated desktop environment.
metadata.infeasibility_reason: Requires AI face detection and advanced facial manipulation not available in GIMP

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - GIMP lacks AI-powered face detection and age manipulation capabilities
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the semantically correct choice for tasks that cannot be completed or verified
Metadata provides clear and accurate explanation of why the task is impossible
This is a special but valid case where infeasible() serves as a semantic marker that the task cannot be evaluated
